title: [profiler][cupti] Tests for .pftrace export
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #191668

Add test/profiler/test_cupti_monitor.py coverage for the Perfetto-native export path.
The parity tests stub the native encoder and compare the shaped inputs it would receive
against the chrome JSON built from the same window, so they stay pure host-side; the
end-to-end tests run the real encoder, gunzip its output, and decode the protobuf with a
minimal hand-rolled scanner, since neither trace_processor nor the perfetto python
bindings are available in CI.

Stacked on the native encoder and Python export commits.

Test Plan:

```
python test/profiler/test_cupti_monitor.py TestCuptiRecords
# 38 passed
```

Runs the .pftrace tests added here with the rest of the host-side suite: slice-for-slice
and lane-order parity against the chrome path, interned categories + trace time base, and
the real-encoder round trips for collective metadata, graph annotations, and graph-node
dependency arrows.

This PR was authored with the assistance of an AI coding assistant.
